events.text: I'll start by checking whether the Day 0 r5 run is still moving, then pick up from the first unreviewed card.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check Day 0 r5 log age and tail
events.input: $ ls -la revops-os/tests/runs-d0-r5.log 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; wc -l revops-os/tests/runs-d0-r5.log 2>/dev/null; echo "---TAIL---"; tail -30 revops-os/tests/runs-d0-r5.log 2>/dev/null; echo "---MTIME---"; stat -f "%Sm" -t "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S" revops-os/tests/runs-d0-r5.log 2>/dev/null; date "+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"

events.name: Bash
events.head: List test harness and run directories
events.input: $ ls -la revops-os/tests/ 2>/dev/null | head -80; echo "==== RUNS ===="; ls -la revops-os/tests/runs/ 2>/dev/null | head -40

events.text: The r5 run stalled at 16:42 in a usage-limit wait loop. Let me see which process owns it and how far the reviews got.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find the r5 harness process and review files
events.input: $ ps aux | grep -E "run.py|claude" | grep -v grep | awk '{print $2, $9, $11, $12, $13, $14, $15, $16}' | head -40; echo "=== d0-r5 dir ==="; ls -la revops-os/tests/runs/d0-r5/; echo "=== log dir ==="; ls revops-os/tests/runs/d0-r5/log/ 2>/dev/null | head -60
